name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-05-19, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.81 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
